decision: General normative legal instruments are maintained in Normative MASTER. Individual orders for protected sites/territories are maintained via a separate registry/resolver. No mass collection of 32 protected-zone orders or the specific Sveti Duh order is a prerequisite for closing the general normative archive.

excludes: individual designation/amendment orders for protected zones and territories
normative_master.completeness_gate: mandatory full texts, annexes, effective dates, authoritative provenance and verified links for in-scope general legislation

includes: Natura 2000 zone designation orders and amendments
territorial_orders_resolver.lookup: on demand by the exact identified protected zone/territory and applicable date
territorial_orders_resolver.missing_order_behavior: mark UNVERIFIED, retain source URL, request expert validation; do not fabricate order number, date or legal rule
territorial_orders_resolver.protected_area_case: Sveti Duh was only a test case, not mandatory fixed record

workflow: case files and confirmed subject -> parcels -> GIS identifies intersecting zone/territory IDs (or relevant nearby zones for A)
resolve specific applicable orders from protected-site/territory sources with explicit category and effective date
retrieve general in-scope law from Normative MASTER and specific order from territorial resolver
propose a substantiated procedural route and expose evidence and uncertainty for expert confirmation; never automatically assert an unverifiable legal proposition

required: route-based mapping to 22 administrative paths using general acts and statutory competence
dynamic territorial resolver must be designed and testable for relevant cases but need not prearchive every order
regression suite on existing A, B and B+ZT baselines
not_required: bulk download of all 32 designation orders as normative_master content
fixed Sveti Duh order as a general normative prerequisite

remaining_real_work: Verify remaining general legal texts, amendments and annexes against authoritative sources
Determine which additional subordinate acts actually apply across 22 procedural routes
Build design contract for territory-order dynamic lookup with source validation and fallback
Only then approve integration through a separate control point
